en: A black‑and‑white postcard view of a rural town nestled in a valley, with fields and forested hills rising behind it. A prominent church with a tall tower and onion-shaped spire stands on the right side among clustered houses with steep gabled roofs. On the hill in the background, a small tower or ruin is visible near the summit. Along the bottom margin of the image, there is a handwritten-style caption.
